notes.title: Hotfix 1.212
notes.content: Fixed the new Questions not popping up when we use the new 'ReturntoSuspect' button.

notes.title: Interrogation Simulator Version 1.2 is live!
notes.content:
Greetings, Interrogator!

Many thanks to the community for encouraging me to continue updating this game.

- Rapport/Pressure bars now flash when they stop the Suspect from answering.
- There is now a 'Return to Suspect' button. This should make it easier to jump between Case File and Suspect.

- Music!
- Voice effects!

I hope this update will increase our Rapport!

I'm going to release Case 10 for free in the near future, then I will start work on Interrogation Simulator Volume 2. Thanks for all the support!

Cheers,
Otis

notes.title: Dev Live Stream
notes.content:
I'll start work on the 1.2 update of Interrogation Simulator. 

Join us to learn a little bit about game development and make requests for what you'd like to see in this update!

notes.title: Interrogation Simulator 1.1 Update!
notes.content:
Interrogation Simulator 1.1
- Big overhaul to UI.
- More satisfying score updates.
- More immersive 3d Case Files.
- Now you have to read the Evidence in order to get a Question out of it.

All together, I think the game is much more immersive. Really excited to release this update.

Stay tuned for more updates and cases!

notes.title: Interrogation Simulator + Steam Winter Sale 2022!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

We're really happy to announce that [b]Interrogation Simulator will be a part of this 2022 Steam Winter Sale[/b]: now is a great time to get the game for yourself or your loved ones! 

Remember you can always [url=https://discord.gg/bwzcjxN9]join our Discord[/url] if you have any questions or suggestions for our team. We're thankful to have you as part of our little family. 

We hope you have an amazing Holiday! 

Cheers!
The FCG team.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.05
notes.content: Fixed the resolution issue. Apologies for such a silly bug!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.04
notes.content:
Fixed issue with resolutions. Unsupported resolutions can now no longer be selected.

If you have changed the resolution and can no longer find the Options button, it should be accessible from the Interrogation Panel.

notes.title: Interrogation Simulator: Dev Interrogation
notes.content:
It's our dev's turn to sit on the suspect chair: you can ask him anything related to [b]Interrogation Simulator![/b]

Curious about the inspiration? Want to know more about the process? Will he be adding more case files to the game? When can we expect updates? These, and any other question you might have, now is the time to ask!

notes.title: Interrogation Simulator: Developer Livestream
notes.content:
As a part of the [b]NextFest[/b] events, join our developer while he plays a full round of the game and elaborates on mechanics and narrative development of the title.

Join us on this happy occasion and explore infamous crimes with us!
